fields.Name: C1 -> S3.3
fields.Description: Gate G7.6 (owner PR 5, phase 7, dataset C1, criterion S3.3): scoring a C1 model with a job-title Feature Pipeline version other than the one it is pinned to is refused, 1 of 1. On the C1 corpus (truth:load-c1), a fixture job-title pipeline holds version 1 (Active, ungated) and version 2 (Retired) with planted values for both; a C1 renewal pipeline with an llm-derived step is trained (pinned at train time to version 1, carried in its lineage); the Active version then moves to 2 and the model is scored on the model path (Score Record Set): refused feature-version-mismatch naming version 1 pinned and version 2 active, a refused MJ: ML Scoring Runs row, 0 Feature Values written. Server transport (the planted values are saved through the Feature Pipelines write path's authorisation). Needs the truth sidecar. Mutation: remove the pin comparison (ScoringService.CheckFeaturePins) -> red.
